generation_mode: Reference-based regeneration of dark faceted artwork, followed by a light-theme companion edit.

variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Asset type: a finished 3:2 landscape abstract geometric website background, 1536 x 1024, DARK theme companion artwork.
Input image: edit target and composition/style reference, progress-night-1536-optimized.webp. Regenerate the artwork beautifully from this reference. Retain its irregular triangular folded-facet construction, shallow architectural relief, large crisp planar triangles, connected shared vertices, broad quiet upper-left and center-left text space, and diagonal growth of geometry from the bottom edge into the right edge. No new subject or objects.
PRIMARY CHANGE: Make the edges and intersections visibly more expressive, creatively woven from ALL THREE project level colors, not almost all purple. Turn many actual bevels, folds and long connected diagonal ridges into elegant crisp colored light-catching edges. A connected lime edge can continue into a teal edge at a real shared vertex, then into a lilac fold. Thread the colors through multiple separate long paths across the lower border, lower-middle, center-right and upper-right. Show distinct lime, teal and lilac edges in each major geometric area; do not isolate lime and teal into two tiny glints. Approximately equal visual weight of the three colors among highlighted edges. Some adjacent triangular faces pick up restrained satin color reflections matching their own edges, to give the faceted sculpture dimension.
Color palette: near-charcoal graphite canvas #17151d. Low-relief matte planes alternate neutral graphite #24212d and #302b3a, deep muted sage #292e24, dark teal #242f33, shaded plum #2e273d. Edge highlights use lime/citron #d3e38c, turquoise-teal #93d7d0, soft lilac #c5a8f2. Broad faceted fields must remain dark and restrained, colored ridges are clearly visible at thumbnail size. Project palette only, no added orange, pink, blue or bright emerald. No overall purple wash.
Materials: exquisitely precise folded-paper / satin architectural bas-relief CGI, subtle coherent contact shading, fine but clearly visible bevels and angular intersections. Colors belong to physical facet ridges and crease edges, not arbitrarily drawn lines. Sharp straight edges, carefully resolved junctions, no warped polygons. The open left field stays dark neutral and clean, with faceted detail contained mostly in the right 40 percent and bottom strip just like the reference.
Constraints: reproduce the original wide 3:2 aspect ratio, preserve quiet copy space and broad low-poly triangle scale, avoid adding diamond medallions, cubes, small tessellated tiles or unrelated motifs. No neon tubes, glowing haze, cyberpunk grid, glitter, particles, texture noise, thick outlines, rainbow gradients, cables, floating fragments, typography, logos, watermark, frame, collage or UI. Opaque background. One complete full-frame image.

Use case: lighting-weather / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a finished 3:2 landscape abstract geometric website background, 1536 x 1024, LIGHT THEME companion.
Input image: the dark faceted artwork is the EDIT TARGET. Create its exact corresponding LIGHT version. Preserve the original geometry and composition: the same large irregular triangular facets, exact same vertices, edge paths, straight ridges, shallow fold relief, diagonal growth along the bottom and right edges, framing and broad clean upper-left / center-left empty field. Change only material colors, illumination and theme. Do not add or rearrange geometry.
Make the image airy, elegant, bright and tactile, using the project's light theme palette. The open background is very pale neutral pearl #f0edf4, nearly white, without an overall purple cast. Give the existing triangular planes alternating subtle pale citron/lime #e6efa9 and #f5f7e5, pale mint/teal #d6efeb and #edf8f6, and pale lilac #e9dcfb and #f5effc, alongside pearl-white and light neutral grey faces. Each of these three families should visibly appear across the sculpture, with equal visual weight, especially on the middle-right, upper-right and lower edge. No dark charcoal or black planes.
Preserve the creatively connected tri-color ridge system of the reference, mapping each existing dark-theme lime edge to a refined light-theme olive-citron edge, each teal edge to soft turquoise-teal, each lilac edge to lavender-violet. Use softly desaturated mid-tone tints derived from light palette accents #465c16, #005b64, #6841ab, with the full deeper accent only on exceptionally thin ridge shadow lines. Colored edges must remain clearly legible against pale faces. Let their color follow real physical bevels and folds, meet exactly at the same shared vertices and lightly reflect onto the adjoining plane. The lime, teal and lilac paths should all be easy to see, not just lavender with two tiny color touches.
Lighting and materials: bright diffuse studio light, satin-matte folded-paper / architectural bas-relief CGI, coherent very soft pale contact shadows, crisp fine bevels, beautiful planar faces. No glow. The artwork retains the same low-poly triangle scale and sophisticated calm of the dark reference. The left open text field remains almost white and clean.
Constraints: one opaque full-frame 3:2 image. Exact counterpart of reference silhouette, geometry, angular ridge locations and framing. No diamond medallions, small mosaic tiles, new objects, neon lighting, metallic chrome, glossy plastic, rainbow wash, orange/pink/blue extra colors, particles, grain, noise, wrinkled folds, wavy edges, misshapen triangles, thick outlines, text, letters, logos, watermark, border, collage or UI.
